content: We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule reproduces the described forward reaction: aromatic amine attacks electrophilic sulfur of phenylsulfonyl chloride, then collapse to expel Cl- and base deprotonates N-H to give sulfonamide. So functional group formed: sulfonamide (N-S bond). Bond broken: S-Cl bond. So we need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "sulfonamides"? The functional groups list maybe includes "sulfonamide". Also broken functional group: "chloride"? But they specify S-Cl bond broken. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_formed: "sulfonamides". functional_groups_broken maybe "chloride"? Not sure. Also bonds_broken: "S-Cl". Let's try.
